B3LYP def2-SVP Opt Freq TightSCF NORI NoAutoStart
%pal nprocs 4 end
%maxcore 1024
%scf MaxIter 256 ConvForced true AutoTRAH false end
%geom MaxIter 128 EnforceStrictConvergence true end
%method Z_MaxIter 128 end
* xyzfile 0 1 ethanol.xyz
